title: Strategic Trajectory Brief and Decision Memo for Q1 Roadmap Gates
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: What: Produce a compact strategic brief (1-2 pages) + decision memo and a 12-slide deck for the Q1 roadmap gate review. Who: PM, Eng leads for runtime and dedicated, Design for slides, Finance for cost delta analysis. Why: Create a single source of truth for execs to decide on prioritization across: (a) runtime batching / KV cache optimizations, (b) Dedicated capacity pricing & SLA commitments, and (c) Private deployment compliance milestones. Outcome: Clear go/no-go decisions and a prioritized set of actions with owners and timelines for the next cycle.
acceptance_criteria: One-page decision memo reviewed by Eng, Finance, and Design
12-slide deck completed and rehearsed with exec sponsor
Data appendix with perf benchmarks and cost delta for top three options attached
Explicit recommendations with trade-off table (latency vs cost vs delivery risk)
Decision checklist populated with owners and target completion dates
slides_and_artifacts: Google Slides: Q1 Roadmap Gate Deck - v0.3
PRD links for candidate initiatives (links in brief)
decisions_needed: Approve funding reallocation of up to $350k to runtime perf optimizations this quarter?
Greenlight Dedicated pricing tier changes and target SLA launch window (May vs June)?
Authorize postponement of non-critical Private deployment compliance items until Q3 if resource constrained?
Select primary success metric for rollout gating: p50 latency vs cost-per-token vs sustained throughput?
metrics_and_okrs: OKR: Reduce median generation latency by 20% across typical request mix by EOY
OKR: Lower per-token serving cost by 15% for hosted API in top 5 models
Metric: 99th percentile tail latency for chat workloads (target < 600ms)
Metric: Number of active customers on Private deploy with compliance attestations
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Reallocating eng effort to runtime features delays Dedicated GA - Mitigation: propose phased schedule with a thin GA for Dedicated core features and delayed non-essential add-ons
Risk: Execs push for aggressive SLA without capacity - Mitigation: include fallback policy and phased SLA commitments tied to capacity expansion milestones
Risk: Cost model assumptions are stale - Mitigation: include sensitivity analysis and request updated finance sign-off before final decision
next_steps: By 2026-03-08: Eng to finalize perf benchmark comparisons for candidate runtime changes (owner: Priya)
